ideas.sourceBook: Inner Sound: Altered States of Consciousness in Electronic Music and Audio-Visual Media
ideas.prompt: Using Jonathan Weinel — Inner Sound: Altered States of Consciousness in Electronic Music and Audio-Visual Media as the source, write an audio-visual brief where every light change is triggered by a musical function. Apply it to Ableton clip scene with one performable macro. Primary focus: trance film. Make the result specific enough that it can become an eight- or sixteen-bar Neon Orbit sketch, with one clear sound choice, one structural action, and one listener-state intention.
